At income 1,250, remaining amounts fall to 65 or 85 before other costs, making missing costs and disruption important. A responsible answer can choose either, defer, or seek advice; it must explain affordability, access, written terms, verification, and gaps. Include offline emergency contacts and safe household responsibilities. A written menu does not demonstrate cooking.
